subject: Request: Strategic payment window & conditional quarterly invoicing for Sparkline
messages:
From: Alex Serrano <alex@sparkline.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sparkline.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment cadence ask for initial deployment

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a request from finance: they want quarterly invoicing aligned to Sparkline's fiscal quarters (Jun/Sep/Dec/Mar) with a 60-day payment window from invoice date for the first two quarters while we ramp usage; after that they'd move to standard Net-30.

Key ask summary: 
- Quarterly invoices (one invoice per fiscal quarter)
- Net-60 for first two quarters (to smooth cash flow during integration ramp)
- One-time usage credit (up to $15k) if we miss onboarding milestones (we'll provide milestone doc)

They attached a short template with the payment request and the provisional milestone table. Can your team confirm if Redwood can accept the quarterly cadence paired with the temporary Net-60? If not, any alternative (e.g., billed monthly but pay Net-60) would still be helpful.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Alex
Account Lead, Sparkline AI

Attachment: sparkline_credit_request.xlsx (xlsx)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Alex Serrano <alex@sparkline.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment cadence ask for initial deployment

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. Looping in Grace (Sales Ops) and Jonas (FP&A) to assess cash / ARR implications, and Laura from Legal to sanity-check contract language.

Preliminary thoughts from my side: I understand why Sparkline wants invoice alignment with their quarters. From Redwood's perspective, quarterly invoices with a temporary Net-60 isn't our default for new enterprise deals, but it's something we've approved on a case-by-case basis when there are mitigating controls (e.g., credit hold triggers, milestone acceptance gates, and an initial prepay or deposit).

A few questions for Sparkline (cc'd):
- Is there an initial deposit or prepay you're able to provide for first-quarter exposure?
- Can the milestone acceptance criteria be embedded in the SOW so we can tie credits to objective events?

Grace/Jonas/Laura — could you weigh in on whether FP&A would accept the two-quarter Net-60 pilot if we secure a 30% prepayment of the first-quarter invoice and include a maximum liability cap equal to three months of committed MRR?

Next steps for us: I'll draft a short exec request to ask for conditional approval (will capture ARR impact and proposed safeguards) and loop you back.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_sow_v2_draft.pdf (pdf)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment cadence ask for initial deployment

Marcus / Grace — reviewed the numbers in the HubSpot record and the attached credit request. High-level FP&A position: we can support a temporary Net-60 for up to two quarters provided ALL of the following are in place: 

1) A 30% prepayment of the first quarter's committed invoice deposited before Go-Live.
2) A contracted cap on total outstanding receivables tied to committed MRR (recommendation: cap = 3x committed monthly run rate).
3) Milestone acceptance criteria in the SOW that trigger any usage credits (credits must be tin-capped and require sign-off from both sides).
4) Redwood maintains right to suspend service after a 90-day past-due trigger (escalation path to Enterprise Success).

If those controls can be written into the SOW/term sheet, I give conditional finance approval. We'll need a short exec sign-off to grant this exception for Sparkline — can you put that together, Marcus? I'll include an ARR impact summary for the approval note.

Jonas Weber
Director, FP&A

Subject: Exec approval request — conditional quarterly invoicing + two-quarter Net-60 pilot for Sparkline (Deal: SPK-2027-042)

Team — requesting quick exec sign-off for a controlled exception on payment terms for Sparkline AI. Summary below; total ask is time-limited and includes concrete mitigations.

Deal background:
- Account: Sparkline AI (early-stage ML infra company)
- ARR: $540k committed first-year run rate
- Contract: 12-month term, SOW includes integration milestones

Request:
- Quarterly invoicing aligned to Sparkline fiscal quarters (Jun/Sep/Dec/Mar)
- Temporary Net-60 for the first two quarters only, reverting to Net-30 thereafter
- Usage credits up to $15k tied to milestone acceptance

Proposed safeguards (required for approval):
- 30% prepayment of the first-quarter invoice due before Go-Live (reduces initial exposure)
- Receivable cap = 3x committed monthly run rate (limits unpaid exposure)
- Milestone acceptance language in SOW with mutual sign-off; credits are capped and require both parties' sign-off
- Finance will monitor DSO monthly and reserve right to halt service on 90-day delinquency

Financial impact: Jonas will append a short ARR / cashflow note to the record (see HubSpot link). With the 30% prepay and receivable cap, the short-term cash impact is manageable; the exception materially increases sales velocity for this account and preserves a strategically important reference customer in AI tooling.

Recommendation: Approve conditional exception per the safeguards above. If approved, Legal (Laura) will incorporate the terms into the SOW/term sheet and Sales will collect the prepayment before Go-Live.

Attachments: signed_term_sheet_stub.pdf (pdf)
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/SPK-2027-042

--
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
